poses.caption: Lie prone with hips supported on the ball and both hands on the floor, legs lowered straight behind
Lift both straight legs behind while keeping hips on the ball and hands planted

jobs.detail: REVERSE HYPEREXTENSION ON STABILITY BALL, TWO phases. Full body SIDE three-quarter view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, ONE large round gray full stability ball under PELVIS/hips, body prone face DOWN. BOTH palms firmly flat on FLOOR in front of ball under shoulders, arms nearly straight, neck neutral eyes toward floor. Ball supports abdomen/pelvis at same place/height and ball size/location unchanged. BOTH legs straight together behind, knees extended in both poses. LEFT LOWER: straight legs slope down from hips to shoes just above floor or toes lightly touch floor, no knee bend. RIGHT RAISED: lift BOTH straight legs behind until near torso height, feet clearly higher than lowered phase, hips stay supported ball, no extreme lumbar arch/neck lift. Upper body/hands stay same, only hip extension changes, two legs continuous hip-thigh-knee-shoe, no extra limb. Primary GLUTES only ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED RED patch over side/rear hip of continuous opaque BLACK shorts, no radial fiber rays/muscle divisions or cutaway in fabric. All exposed limbs fine detailed grayscale anatomy, shirt/shorts full front sides back seat crotch. Whole ball/model/shoes/hands fit frame, no text.

jobs.detail: REVERSE LUNGE TO FORWARD LEG KICK, THREE phases, full body SIDE three-quarter view model faces IMAGE LEFT, same camera. RIGHT leg is moving leg in ALL phases; LEFT leg stays supporting. LEFT LUNGE: RIGHT foot steps BACK toward IMAGE RIGHT, right knee bends near floor beneath hip, right heel up toes floor; LEFT foot forward IMAGE LEFT flat and left knee90degrees, torso upright hands hips. MIDDLE RETURN: stand upright left foot planted same location, RIGHT foot lifted behind slightly as it swings through (right knee flex), body balanced over LEFT foot, hands hips. RIGHT KICK: RIGHT leg swings FORWARD toward IMAGE LEFT, knee extends straight for a modest waist-height kick, RIGHT shoe clear in air in front, LEFT supporting leg nearly straight foot flat. Torso tall with only slight natural lean, hips level, hands hips throughout. Trace same RIGHT hip-thigh-knee-shoe from rear lunge through forward kick; do not kick left support leg or change sides between phases. Both legs/hands/shoes fully inside each panel; no equipment. Primary GLUTES only soft diffuse blurred red tint on intact opaque BLACK side/rear hip shorts, no radial rays/anatomical fibers/divisions through cloth; all exposed legs/arms fine grayscale anatomy. Full opaque shirt/shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. No text/arrows.
